name: vibe-coding-kickstart
description: Business and technical interviews plus post-build app reviews, comprehensive checklists, and evidence-backed reports.

defaultPrompt: Help me turn my app idea into a small, testable MVP.
Interview me about the next build step in my existing project.
Review my existing app, clarify ambiguity and intended scale, and produce a checklist and report.
interface.longDescription: Interview project owners from idea to release, or inspect an existing app and generate an evidence-backed checklist and review report. Ask focused questions about ambiguity, risk, and intended scale. Cover product behavior, UX, data, access, integrations, testing, performance, operations, and relevant AI risks. Distinguish inspected evidence, executed checks, and unverified claims. Requires access to the app or relevant artifacts for an actual inspection.
